responsibility: Declares the narrow public interface for SSA coalescing during out-of-SSA conversion. It exposes the driver that coalesces var_map partitions and the predicate that tests whether two GIMPLE SSA values are legally coalescible, serving as the companion API to the coalescing implementation rather than defining dataflow analyses itself.
same_name_distinction: This header is the narrow public API for SSA coalescing, declaring only the driver and legality predicate. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-coalesce.cc, it does not build coalesce lists, compute conflict graphs, or perform the partition-merging algorithm.
